title: Quality and Safety
description: Admission NEWS2 and the deterioration proxy by unit and attending specialty, for quality and patient-safety officers. Synthetic data; not for patient care.

panels.title: Admission NEWS2 risk band by unit
panels.description: NEWS2 at the end of each admission's feature window: low 0-4, medium 5-6, high 7 or more (Royal College of Physicians 2017).

targets.sql: select admissions.unit, case when news2.news2_total >= 7 then 'High (7+)' when news2.news2_total >= 5 then 'Medium (5-6)' else 'Low (0-4)' end as risk_band, count(*) as admissions from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_admissions as admissions inner join @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_encounter_news2 as news2 on admissions.encounter_key = news2.encounter_key where $__timeFilter(admissions.admitted_at) and news2.news2_total is not null group by 1, 2 order by 1, 2

panels.title: Mean admission NEWS2 by day
panels.description: Mean NEWS2 of the day's admissions by unit.

targets.sql: select date_trunc('day', admissions.admitted_at) as "time", admissions.unit as metric, avg(news2.news2_total) as mean_news2 from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_admissions as admissions inner join @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_encounter_news2 as news2 on admissions.encounter_key = news2.encounter_key where $__timeFilter(admissions.admitted_at) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Deterioration proxy rate by unit
panels.description: Share of training-eligible admissions with the synthetic deterioration proxy label.

targets.sql: select admissions.unit, count(*) as admissions, avg(1.0 * training.deterioration_proxy_label) as deterioration_rate from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_admissions as admissions inner join @@ANALYTICS@@.ml_training_dataset as training on admissions.encounter_key = training.encounter_key where $__timeFilter(admissions.admitted_at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Deterioration proxy rate by attending specialty
panels.description: The same rate by the attending's specialty at admission (synthetic roster).

targets.sql: select admissions.attending_specialty, count(*) as admissions, avg(1.0 * training.deterioration_proxy_label) as deterioration_rate from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_admissions as admissions inner join @@ANALYTICS@@.ml_training_dataset as training on admissions.encounter_key = training.encounter_key where $__timeFilter(admissions.admitted_at) group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: Admissions by diagnosis source
panels.description: Admitting diagnoses from the patient's Synthea history or the simulator's fallback.

targets.sql: select diagnosis_source, count(*) as admissions from @@ANALYTICS@@.fact_admissions where $__timeFilter(admitted_at) group by 1 order by 2 desc
